entities.name: Alexio
entities.description: Skyguard from Meletis with wings of light who gave his life to protect Iris.

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: Blind Oracle of Ephara targeted for kidnapping by agents of Purphoros.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: City on Theros ruled by the Twelve.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: Head Speaker who ordered Alexio to escort Iris to Soli.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose agents were sent to kidnap Iris.

entities.name: Soli
entities.description: Garrison where Iris was to be safe.

events.summary: Alexio is summoned by the Twelve and told to secretly escort Iris to the garrison at Soli.
events.quote: Head Speaker Perisophia told Alexio that he would escort Iris in secret to the garrison at Soli

events.summary: Alexio and Iris ride out toward Soli; Alexio spots highwaymen in ambush.
events.quote: highwaymen who were waiting in ambush

events.summary: Alexio rescues Iris from her horse and kills the two ambushers, whose weapons are Purphoran.
events.quote: The two men charged, but he killed them both in quick succession.

events.summary: Alexio finds a loyal pegasus and they fly together.
events.quote: Alexio tracked down a loyal pegasus

events.summary: Sheltering from a storm in a cave, Alexio and Iris fall in love and spend the night together.
events.quote: The two spent the night entwined

events.summary: Attackers close in on the cave; Alexio is shot, sends Iris away on the pegasus, and stays to face the bandits.
events.quote: He faced off against several bandits inside the cave

relations.note: He fell in love with her and she with him.
relations.quote: He had fallen in love with her
Alexio had been summoned to the council of the Twelve

relations.note: His agents were sent to kidnap her.
relations.quote: agents of Purphoros had been sent to kidnap Iris
